install.windows_download: Resolve the current Windows x64 installer from https://open-design.ai/download/ or the official nexu-io/open-design GitHub release; download to Downloads and open it.
install.macos_download: Resolve the current official DMG for the machine architecture (Apple Silicon or Intel) from https://open-design.ai/download/ and install Open Design.app in Applications.
install.linux_download: The vendor currently provides no prebuilt Linux desktop package. Follow the official QUICKSTART.md source setup with Node 24 and the repository-pinned pnpm through Corepack. Install dependencies, then run pnpm tools-dev for the desktop shell. Create ~/.local/bin/open-design as a launcher for pnpm tools-dev in that checkout and a desktop entry named Open Design only after verifying the source launch succeeds.
install.note: Open Design is the nexu-io/open-design desktop design workspace. Preserve existing ~/.amr credentials and Open Design projects. Recheck current official release assets before deciding platform availability.

install_flow.summary: Use the current official installer on Windows/macOS; use the official source workflow on Linux.
agent_steps: Detect OS and CPU architecture; check whether Open Design is already installed before installing anything.
On Windows/macOS download the current matching official installer to Downloads, tell the user the exact path, and open it. Let the user complete any installer wizard.
On Linux explain that the vendor has no prebuilt desktop release, then follow the official source quickstart without substituting an unrelated npm package or a web-only launch.
Refresh EchoBird tool detection and report success only when Open Design is detected. Do not access or change account credentials during installation.
